newsitem.title: FRANCE: Italy, Germany boost French wheat exports -ONIC.
newsitem.headline: Italy, Germany boost French wheat exports -ONIC.

text.p: Buoyant demand from Italy and Germany will lift France's soft wheat exports in 1996/97, officials from national grain office ONIC said on Thursday.
"Within the European Union, Italy is our star outlet...the pace of exports to Germany is also good," director general Alain Moulinier told a news conference.
In a new supply/demand report released ahead of the conference, ONIC raised by 100,000 tonnes its forecast for 1996/97 soft wheat exports to the European Union to 8.940 million tonnes.
This would compare with 8.613 million tonnes of soft wheat exported to other EU partners in 1995/96.
Moulinier said France might export three million tonnes of soft wheat to Italy during the current campaign.
He also said Germany may buy some 800,000 tonnes of French grain this year.
